comment: M05 alpha gate and M05R review round: real cities on RWG2 Continents, seed 4242. Each shot's position and view come from /lostcities find (decision log D115); the monument shot is dropped (AR-15) for the rise cap's view; M06 adds the highway, ramp, station and railway shots.
title: Alpha review: real cities on RWG2 Continents, seed 4242

shots.name: above
shots.caption: City from above: the city nearest the spawn, from south of its center, looking north.

shots.name: street
shots.caption: Street level: the primary street nearest the spawn with open street ahead, from head height.

shots.name: interior
shots.caption: Building interior: the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, looking toward its street door.

shots.name: edge
shots.caption: City edge: where the city meets RWG2 terrain, from just above the land outside it, looking into the city.

shots.name: rise
shots.caption: Rise cap: the city street nearest the spawn beside RWG2 ground at least 12 blocks above it, from above the city looking at the slope. The city stops or steps down here instead of climbing it (AR-4).

shots.name: village
shots.caption: Village sewn into the city: a village's gate where the city's lane meets it, seen from beside the lane, the city on one side and the village on the other. The clearest gate within 48 chunks of the spawn, of the village by the pond that the reserved-lot and soft-edge shots show; 120 chunks out the clearest is a village in a forest of tall trees.

shots.name: reserved
shots.caption: Reserved lot: the margin the city leaves around a VillageNames village, from the south.

shots.name: softedge
shots.caption: Soft edge: the city's margin, a chunk of natural ground the blend slopes from the city's edge to a village's ground, with the strip that meets the village's own edge and the lane's steps; the city builds inside it (AR-10, AR-11).

shots.name: highway
shots.caption: Highway (M06): the straight highway piece above ground nearest the spawn with highway ahead of it, from behind it along its axis, 15 blocks above the deck. Open road in a city, a bridge with railings and supports outside one; the surface is upstream's cyan terracotta.

shots.name: ramp
shots.caption: Highway ramp (M06, AR-10): where a highway climbs or falls a level to reach a city's streets or the ground at a dead end, seen from above the ramp's edge: the deck rises a half block every column or two, with half slabs on the half steps, so it is walked without jumping.

shots.name: station
shots.caption: Railway station (M06): the surface station nearest the spawn, from 30 blocks above it, looking down.

shots.name: railway
shots.caption: Railway (M06): inside the tunnel of the east-west line nearest the spawn, at the track, looking east along the line.
